rationale: The distribution thesis is working as designed — price is grinding lower on persistent lower highs (40.84 → 40.37 over the last 11 candles), remains well below session VWAP ($42.17) and the 9-EMA ($40.62), and is now pressing within 0.21% of the $40.13 day low, whose break opens the unfilled gap toward $38.89 with 8x relative volume and a risk-off tape (SPY -0.66%, VIXY +2.25%) still behind the fade. There is no reversal evidence (no capitulation reclaim, no bounce follow-through) that would justify flipping long at support, and closing now surrenders a functioning setup for only ~1% captured against a $39.40 target. The $40.85 invalidation caps worst-case near -$68, comfortably inside the remaining $469.87 loss budget.
